_comment: DEV ONLY. One dev sign-in account per WordPress user level, the single list read by setup/setup.php (creates the qa-* users), mu-plugins/spokares-dev-login.php (?dev_login=<login>), mu-plugins/spokares-dev-qa.php and the QA crawler and test runners (dev/lib/site.mjs). 'key' is the role key used by dev/qa and dev/tests; 'dev_login' is the ?dev_login= value (defaults to the login); 'caps' are extra per-user capabilities. Every password is "password"; every e-mail is <login>@example.invalid.
